title: Remove bordered/toolbar editor chrome in favor of a borderless content area with a selection-based floating format menu
description: Address item 2 of `novas-tasks.md` (`referencia.png`, `referencia-4.png`): the editable content area currently has a visible border (`.sb-editor .ProseMirror { border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; }` in `editor.css`, darkening to `#888` on focus) and a permanently visible `EditorToolbar.tsx` with Bold/Italic/H1/H2/H3/list/code buttons above the content. Remove the border entirely so the content area reads as plain page content (matching `referencia.png`'s borderless Zeroheight layout). Remove the fixed toolbar. Formatting becomes available exclusively via: (a) keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+B, Cmd+I, etc. — StarterKit already binds these, just no longer needs a visible button), (b) markdown input rules (e.g. `**bold**`, `# heading`, already partly supported by StarterKit's input rules — verify/extend coverage), and (c) a new Tiptap `BubbleMenu` that appears above the current text selection with style controls (Bold, Italic, Underline, headings, lists, code, link) matching the floating toolbar shown in `referencia-4.png`.
acceptanceCriteria: `.sb-editor .ProseMirror` no longer renders a visible border or focus border-color change
`EditorToolbar.tsx`'s fixed, always-visible toolbar is removed from `ContentEditor.tsx`
Selecting text reveals a floating `BubbleMenu` positioned above the selection with Bold/Italic/Underline/heading-level/list/code/link controls, styled per the editorial design system
Keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+B, +I, etc.) continue to work for all formatting previously exposed by toolbar buttons
Markdown-style input rules (e.g. `# ` for H1, `**text**` for bold) work for the formatting options that had toolbar buttons
No functionality is lost: every action previously reachable via the fixed toolbar remains reachable via shortcut, markdown, or the bubble menu

steps.details: In `editor.css`, remove the `border`/`border-radius`/focus `border-color` rules from `.sb-editor .ProseMirror`, keeping padding/min-height.

Add Tiptap's `BubbleMenu` (or `@tiptap/extension-bubble-menu`) to `extensions.ts`/`ContentEditor.tsx`, building a new floating menu component with the formatting controls previously in `EditorToolbar.tsx`.
Confirm StarterKit's default input rules cover heading (`#`/`##`/`###`), bold (`**`), italic (`_`), lists (`-`/`1.`), and code (`` ` ``); add custom input rules for any gaps.
Delete `EditorToolbar.tsx`'s rendering from `ContentEditor.tsx` (file removal or emptying, depending on whether any piece is still needed elsewhere).

Confirm borderless content area, bubble menu appears on selection and applies formatting, shortcuts and markdown rules work, and no regressions in table editing (hover controls from TASK-101 must already be in place).

technicalNotes: Depends on TASK-101 because the toolbar's contextual table row/column buttons must already be replaced by hover controls before the toolbar itself is removed.

Reference `referencia-4.png` for the exact floating menu composition: 'Improve with AI' + B/I/U/superscript/code/quote/H2/H3/H4/bullet/ordered/checklist/link — adapt to SystemBook's actual supported marks/nodes, dropping anything not implemented (e.g. no AI features exist in this product).

Implemented as `BubbleFormatMenu.tsx` using `BubbleMenu` imported from `@tiptap/react/menus` (Tiptap v3 moved it out of the old `@tiptap/extension-bubble-menu` React wrapper) — no new direct dependency needed, `@tiptap/extension-bubble-menu` resolves transitively through `@tiptap/react` and typechecks cleanly. Reused the exact button set from the deleted `EditorToolbar.tsx` (H1/H2/H3, Bold/Italic, bullet/ordered list, code block) rather than inventing underline/link/superscript/quote — none of those marks/nodes exist in `extensions.ts`, and adding them was explicitly out of scope. `EditorToolbar.tsx` deleted (`git rm`, no other consumers). Verified via Playwright/Chromium against the real dev app: computed `border-width` on `.sb-editor .ProseMirror` is `0px`, no `[role=toolbar][aria-label=Formação]` renders before a selection exists, selecting text reveals `.sb-bubble-menu`, clicking its Bold button and pressing Cmd/Ctrl+I both toggle marks correctly, and the `# `/`- `/`**bold**` input rules all fire (each extension — Heading/Bold/List — ships its own `addInputRules()` independent of StarterKit, so no gaps existed to fill). Table hover controls (TASK-100) sanity-checked with zero regression. Zero console/page errors.
